'''Ribbo Qua'lu''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Ribbo Qua'lu worked at the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ribbo Qua'lu is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
